arml-1996-superrelay-01.title: Area equation
arml-1996-superrelay-01.body:
$\frac12(2N)(N-2)=N$ gives $N(N-2)=N$, so $N^2-3N=0$ and $N=3$ ($N=0$ gives no triangle).

**Answer: 3**

arml-1996-superrelay-03.title: Vertex
arml-1996-superrelay-03.body:
The vertex of $y=ax^2+bx+c$ has $x=-\frac b{2a}$: here $x=-\frac{T^2}{2T}=-\frac T2=2$. So $C=2$.

**Answer: 2**

arml-1996-superrelay-05.title: Last digits
arml-1996-superrelay-05.body:
Modulo $10$: $199^8\cdot279^7\equiv9^8\cdot9^7=9^{15}\equiv9$ (powers of $9$ alternate $9,1,9,1,\dots$ and $15$ is odd). The units digit is $9$.

**Answer: 9**

arml-1996-superrelay-07.title: Angle sums
arml-1996-superrelay-07.body:
Interior angles sum to $(T-2)180^\circ=1080^\circ$; exterior angles sum to $360^\circ$. The difference is $720^\circ$.

**Answer: $720^\circ$**

arml-1996-superrelay-08.title: Equilateral triangle
arml-1996-superrelay-08.body:
$K=12$. An equilateral triangle with height $K$ has side $\frac{2K}{\sqrt3}$ and area $A=\frac{K^2}{\sqrt3}$. Then $\frac{A\sqrt3}9=\frac{K^2}9=\frac{144}9=16$.

**Answer: 16**

arml-1996-superrelay-09.title: Angle subtraction
arml-1996-superrelay-09.body:
Since $286^\circ=180^\circ+106^\circ$, $\cos286^\circ=-\cos106^\circ$, and $\sin(-106^\circ)=-\sin106^\circ$. So the left side is $-\sin T^\circ\cos106^\circ+\cos T^\circ\sin106^\circ=\sin(106^\circ-T^\circ)$. For $T=16$ this is $\sin90^\circ=1$, so $\theta=90^\circ$ and $\cos\theta+i\sin\theta=i$.

**Answer: $i$**

arml-1996-superrelay-12.title: Cofunction identity
arml-1996-superrelay-12.body:
$\tan99^\circ=\cot\theta=\tan(90^\circ-\theta)$, so $90^\circ-\theta\equiv99^\circ\pmod{180^\circ}$, and $\theta\equiv-9^\circ\pmod{180^\circ}$. The only value in $(-90^\circ,90^\circ)$ is $\theta=-9^\circ$.

**Answer: $-9^\circ$**

arml-1996-superrelay-15.title: Diagonal tiles
arml-1996-superrelay-15.body:
$2T^2+5=37$ is odd. For an $n\times n$ floor the diagonals contain $2n$ tiles if $n$ is even and $2n-1$ if $n$ is odd. So $2n-1=37$, $n=19$, and the floor has $19^2=361$ tiles.

**Answer: 361**
